next.reason: §2023:8.3.5 SR2 keeps 'comma and semicolon, immediately followed by a space, are separators' without 1985's 'Except when the comma is used in a PICTURE character-string'. The exception was idle in 1985: a picture string ends at a separator (§1985:IV.4.2.1 SR9), so a picture comma followed by a space is the last symbol, and §1985:VI.5.9.5 GR4 says it 'must be immediately followed by the separator period'. §2023:13.18.40.3 SR7 keeps that rule ('shall be followed immediately (without an intervening separator space) by the separator period'). No conforming 1985 program changes meaning.
